title: Elihu Speaks: God Is Not Affected by Sin

questions.question: Do you think this to be just? Do you say, 'It is my right before whom?'
questions.explanation: Job 35:2 (ESV): "Do you think this to be just? Do you say, 'It is my right before God,'"

questions.question: If you sin, what do you accomplish against whom?
questions.explanation: Job 35:6 (ESV): "If you sin, what do you accomplish against him? And if your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?"

questions.question: If you are righteous, what do you give to him? Or what does he receive from your what?
questions.explanation: Job 35:7 (ESV): "If you are righteous, what do you give to him? Or what does he receive from your hand?"

questions.question: Your wickedness concerns a man like yourself, and your righteousness a son of whom?
questions.explanation: Job 35:8 (ESV): "Your wickedness concerns a man like yourself, and your righteousness a son of man."

questions.question: Because of the multitude of oppressions people cry out; they call for help because of the arm of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 35:9 (ESV): "Because of the multitude of oppressions people cry out; they call for help because of the arm of the mighty."

questions.question: But none says, 'Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the what?'
questions.explanation: Job 35:10 (ESV): "But none says, 'Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,'"

questions.question: Who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the what?
questions.explanation: Job 35:11 (ESV): "who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds of the heavens?"

questions.question: There they cry out, but he does not answer, because of the pride of what kind of men?
questions.explanation: Job 35:12 (ESV): "There they cry out, but he does not answer, because of the pride of evil men."

questions.question: Surely God does not hear an empty cry, nor does the Almighty regard it. How much less when you say that you do not what?
questions.explanation: Job 35:13–14 (ESV): "Surely God does not hear an empty cry... How much less when you say that you do not see him..."

questions.question: Job opens his mouth in empty talk; he multiplies words without what?
questions.explanation: Job 35:16 (ESV): "Job opens his mouth in empty talk; he multiplies words without knowledge."

questions.question: Look at the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds, which are higher than what?
questions.explanation: Job 35:5 (ESV): "Look at the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds, which are higher than you."

questions.question: Wait for him, because the case is before whom?
questions.explanation: Job 35:14 (ESV): "that the case is before him, and you must wait for him."

questions.question: And now, because his anger does not punish, and he does not take much note of what?
questions.explanation: Job 35:15 (ESV): "And now, because his anger does not punish, and he does not take much note of transgression,"

questions.question: When Elihu speaks of God giving songs in the night, he refers to God giving what in dark times?
questions.explanation: Metaphorical understanding of Job 35:10, implying comfort or cause for valid praise even in suffering.

questions.question: What is the main point of Elihu's argument in Chapter 35?
options: God is transcendent and not affected by human actions
questions.correctAnswer: God is transcendent and not affected by human actions
questions.explanation: The chapter focuses on how man's righteousness or sin does not change God (v6-7).

key_verse_text: But none says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
